snippet.title: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables - Trailer
snippet.description:
I used to not be a brain in a jar, now I am a brain in a jar.

I have these power cables connected to me, I gotta plug them into the socket, makes me and it happy! Sometimes its very very difficult to do so, pls try your best!

Out October 21. Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5104990?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer

Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/QcCr3EEnRb

Visit the website:
https://narnok.com

Features:
  - Grab the plug, swing it, stretch it and throw it: the cable is all physics
  - Water that shocks, glass you can smash, glue, fans, belts, doors and bouncers
  - Spiders, slugs and gummy worms that make plugging things in even less reasonable
  - A full level editor with Steam Workshop sharing
  - Steam achievements and Steam Cloud saves

Programming / Project Lead: danmastrow
Music: NARNOK by leafcuts
